_comment: Who's who, for the editing pipeline. Maps each mate across the three things the cut-list needs to line up: their Discord audio track (Craig names files by Discord user), their in-game name (telemetry logs this on every mark/sample), the capture angle/rig their POV is on, and a colour for captions/lower-thirds. Same crew each week, so this is a small static file you nudge when someone new joins. Fill in the real values before the first shoot.

angles.director-1: Spare PC A — director cam (auto-follow the action)
angles.director-2: Spare PC B — director cam (second angle / wide)
angles.player: the mate's own machine, their POV
